Sticky: Throws a projectile that unleashes sticky thread in an area. Costs 50 MP - 3s Cooldown (1s with Mastery)
Steel: Throws a projectile that unleashes sticky-steel thread in an area. Costs 100 MP. Costs 50 MP - 3s Cooldown (1s with Mastery)
Slinger: Sends out a web projectile to the block the player is looking at.
If it lands, the web string will be attached to that landed block, the player can crouch to get pulled to the attached block, there will be no fall damage as long as they are below the Y level of the attached block.
The string will dissolve after 60s, when the length exceeds 50 blocks, when the player reaches the attached block or when the player shift activates this mode again.
If the web projectile hits an entity instead, attach it to that entity and this will work like a Lead but the entity doesn’t take fall damage as long as its Y level is lower than the user’s, crouch to pull the entity closer to the user, the string will snap if it exceeds 30 blocks length (this will reverse if the target is 3 times bigger than the user or have higher EP than user). Cost 200 MP.
Arcane Thread Fetters (Requires Learning): Encases the looked at mob in 10 block radius (20 with mastery) in sticky-steel thread for 25 seconds.
Once activated again, during 5s (10s with Mastery) since encasing it, while looking at an encased mob, deal 30 (60 with Mastery) damage to the mob, remove the webbed effect. Costs 200 MP - 5s cooldown (3s with Mastery)
This Art is affected by Abilities that apply effects on attack like Corrosion, Poison, [Shadow Striker]'s Insta-kill, etc.

By obtaining the mythical Hero Egg, the veil of deception is torn apart. No illusion or concealment can deceive your sight, and your vision becomes perfect.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Grants the user perfect vision and can see through ANY illusion and concealment (e.g. Falsifier, Haze,...).
With this skill you can also tell if someone is faking something with Falsifier
Acts like magic sense (night vision)
Cannot be used without Hero Egg or True Hero

Empower your allies to fight with you and benefit from their fait, start subjugating it!

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Unbreakable Defense:
This toggle requires at least 2,000 Loyalty points from all your subordinates.
Starting at 2,000 Loyalty, gain 2% Damage Reduction, up to a maximum of 50% at 50,000 Loyalty points.
Killing the user’s loyal subordinates is the only way to weaken this defense.
Only the loyalty points of nearby subordinates (within the range of Undying Loyalty) is considered for your defense. While Unbreakable Defense is toggled, the user can no longer utilize their Skills, Magic and Battlewill. Only Physical attacks and Haki can be used.
Passive: [Passive, In Slot] Undying Loyalty:
Loyalty will build two points (four on mastery) at a time on nearby subordinates (8 block range, doubled on mastery) every five seconds. For every 2,000 total loyalty points up to a maximum of 50,000, strengthen your Unbreakable Defense by 2%.
Use the (Return) mode to retrieve that subordinate’s loyalty points.
Passive: [Passive, Toggle] Under Orders:
Your subjects are loyal and believe in your rule. Upon changing the targeting of a mob, grant them Inspiration I for 30 seconds. On mastery, this upgrades to Inspiration II for one minute.
Passive: [Mastery, Passive, True] Powerful Control:
Any spells or skills that place targets under your control no longer requires you to stare at them for long periods of time. This includes the following:
Greed, Dominate, Demon Dominate, Demon Marionette
Active
[Active, Press] Takeover:
On activation, the target you are looking at instantly gets placed under your control with no wind up. The target’s EP must be lesser than your amount of magicules and cannot exceed 600k EP. On acquiring more Mental Magic, this cap increases by 100k per.
Active: [Active, Press] Thought Domination (Movement):
Allows the user to control their subordinate's movements in a radius around them. There are four available options, "Follow", "Wander", "Stay" and "Meat Shield".
Active: [Active, Press] Thought Domination (Targeting):
Allows the user to control their subordinate's entity targeting in a radius around them. There are four available options, "Passive", "Aggressive", "Neutral" and "Protect".

Dreamer

Passive
[Passive - In Slot] Recall - Restore 0.5% of MP every 5 seconds. On mastery, this upgrades to 1%.
Passive: [Passive - True] Lucid Dream: Death is not the end. If the player had set a Dream before dying, instantly teleport to the location of the Dream, restore all stats, and cheat death. The (Dream) mode goes on a cooldown of 1200 seconds when this happens. (On mastery, reduces to 900 seconds.)
Active
[Active, Press] Dream:
Save your current health, SHP, magicules, aura, and location.
Reactivating Dream will restore your stats back to the saved values and instantly teleport you to the location you saved.
When activated, go on a 1200 second cooldown. (On mastery, reduces to 900 seconds.) Dying will also trigger Dream if you've saved one, see [Lucid Dream]. Crouching and activating will cancel the dream.
Active: [Active, Held] Hypnosis - Induce Drowsiness I (Drowsiness II when mastered) on mobs in a 10 block radius (15 when mastered). All values can be modified in the configuration files.
Active: [Active, Held] Dream Eater:
Holding down the skill while looking at a mob that is Drowsy will deal 30 damage (50 when mastered) and 30 spiritual damage (50 when mastered) after a 5 second timer.
Successfully consuming a dream will reduce (Dream)'s cooldown by 30 seconds. Grants a mastery point as well. All values are configurable in the configuration files.

Restrict teleportation, confuse enemies by swapping places, and use your blink as well as the spatial gate to cross large distances.

Passive
[Passive - True] - With mastery, makes the player immune to severance.
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] - Thought Acceleration
Active
[Active - Press] Spatial Suppression: Inflicts a status debuff to all mobs within a 50x50 radius that prevents them from using teleportation abilities for 60 seconds. Costs 300 MP.
Active: [Active - Press] - Swap: When activated, the player and the mob/enemy/entity that they're looking at swap places [Max range 30 blocks]. Costs 100 MP.
Active: [Active - Press] - Spatial Motion: Blink if not shifting (Costs 10 per block distance), Spatial GUI if shifting (Costs 10 per block distance for instant warp, 5 per for portal)

As the King of Scorpions, your poison is highly dangerous. An upgrade to the Poison skill.

Passive
[Passive, In Slot] Lethal Poison - Inflict powerful lethal poison into any enemy you touch, crippling your victim with Fatal Poison 3. On mastery, this becomes toggleable and becomes Fatal Poison 6.

Repeater? Redstone?

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Repeating Action:
Any physical damage you perform will be repeated a second time.
Active
[Active, Press] Recursion Depth:
When activated, millions and billions of the user from other realities come together for 5 seconds.
Every successive hit in a row decreases the user’s next hit’s damage by 10%, but the target will accumulate damage over the next 5 seconds.
After the timer is up, all the damage you have dealt is added up and multiplied by 1.5x.
Example:
Activate > 50 > 45 > 40.5 > 36.45 > 32.805 > Skill mode ends.
(50 + 45 + 40.5 + 36.45 + 32.805) x 1.5 = 204.755 x 1.5 = 307.1325.
Total Damage: 514.8875
Active: [Active, Press] Flarefrost Storehouse:
The essence of a painful, burning memory has been unlocked. An empty storage sits before you, awaiting power from a strange, two pronged blade.
The essence of a biting embraceful memory has been unlocked. An empty storage sits before you, awaiting power from a strange, long blade.
Press to instantly move the held Memory Blades into your mainhand and offhand, Axiom-first. Crouch and press to manually manipulate the storage.
(To unlock the mode memoires has the be defeated first)

Boosts Gravity skills by a decent amount and allows you to fly without hindrance.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Increases Gravity Damage by 1.5x (Except Gravity Collapse). Also increases falling mace damage. Doesn't Stack with Gravity Domination
Active
[Active - Toggle] - Creative Flight

Manipulate gravity to allow flight, your momentum from before will be continued.

Active
[Active - Hold] - Holding down the activation button gives the user a float effect similar to the shulker’s. Each second the button is held down drains 5 MP from the user.

Weaken gravity around yourself to make movement easier or create a variously sized sphere granting previous effects while debuffing enemies.

Active
[Active - Press] - Creates a barrier that inflicts hostile mobs with a slowness 2 effect and grants allied mobs and the player a speed 2 effect. The range of the barrier can be changed by changing the mode, with a bigger range becoming available once mastery is achieved
The ranges are Self, 10x10, and 20x20. Lasts for 120 seconds and costs 50MP. Doubled to 240 Seconds with Mastery.
Can be removed by shift activating while looking at the field within a 15 block radius.
No English wiki description is available for this skill.

Boosts Gravity skills by a large amount and allows you to fly without hindrance.

Passive

Active
[Active - Toggle] - Creative Flight

Active

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Restores HP at a rate of 2 (4 with Mastery) per 20 ticks, with each activation draining 20 Magicules from the user.

Active

Turn heads as a king of the undead, commanding all nearby undead creatures nearby to attack your appointed target.

Active
